你早(呀): nei3 zou2 (a) - good morning (traditional morning greeting)
我要食饭: ngo5 jiu3 sik6 faan6 - I want to eat a meal
我会食饭: ngo5 wui6 sik6 faan6 - I am going to eat a meal
我会饭: ngo5 wui6 faan6 → not valid - (not valid)
我钟意食饭: ngo5 zung1 ji3 sik6 faan6 - I like to eat, I enjoy eating
我想食饭: ngo5 soeng2 sik6 faan3 - I'm thinking about eating
中: zung1 - in the middle of something
我最钟意: ngo5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 - I like something the most
我最钟意咖喱: ngo5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 gaa3 lei1 - I like curry the most
唔钟意: m4 zung1 ji3 - I don't like
我最唔钟意噪音: ngo5 zeoi3 m4 zung1 ji3 cou3 jam1 - I hate noise the most
